transcription.notes: Received telegram; 191 cipher letters in groups of six (one lost in IRXNO); turning grille.

system.summary: Two systems. (1) The "Clave G.A." card: a digraphic table of 2 rows x 15 columns; a plain letter is one of five row letters (WZCTG or MVPKI) followed by its column letter (BLRAFQENHDXYOSJ) (1432.1-4, 1561.7-13). (2) The "nueva clave" of 18 April 1911: an 8 x 8 turning grille (Fleissner) with 16 holes, blocks of 64 letters, quarter turns clockwise, last block filled with nulls x y z (1551.3-4, 1561.5-13, 1569.3-10).

prior_solution.where: The key card "Clave G.A. (una de las usadas en San Antonio)", CMXV.16.1557.1 scans 12-13, in the same fonds; no decipherment of this telegram on the sheet or in CMXV.18.1795.1.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout directed the work and decided what to publish. Claude (Opus) agents transcribed the card and the telegrams from the CEHM viewer images, ran the preregistered measures and wrote the readings; for the turning grille, after our own attempts failed, Claude Fable 5.2 proposed the grille and the readings in one API run on three telegrams, with one telegram held out; the agents checked the grille with an independent decoder and ran the measure once (failed). No human palaeographer checked the transcriptions.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout (transcription, Clave G.A. validation and readings, grille check and measure, write-up)
Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic), one API run on 1551.3-4, 1561.5-13 and 1569.3-10 (grille proposal and readings; pointed out the joined groups of 1561.7-13)

solution.what: Telegram and key card transcribed from the CEHM viewer images; hashed before any key was tried.

The "Clave G.A." card (CMXV.16.1557.1 scans 12-13) selected among the fonds' cards on the first half of the coded letters; it decodes all six coded words (Galeana, Dr, Ag, Guerrero, Chih, Encinillas), two pairs faulty in transmission.
First held-out measure on two telegrams: 30 letters, car 0.833 vs best control 0.667: too short, not validated.

Preregistered measure run once: the card as is against the period decipherments of eight sibling telegrams, cipher transcribed blind; agreement 0.866 on 769 cipher letters vs at most 0.257 for 400 controls (VALIDATION.md).
Reading checked as Spanish sentences: 19 of 20 words read as sense; Ag not identified.
1561.7-13 and 1561.2-13 transcribed and hashed; 1551.3-4, 1561.5-13, 1569.3-10 and 1561.3-13 transcribed earlier, all before any key was tried.
Every card of the fonds tried on 1551.3-4, 1561.5-13, 1569.3-10, 1561.7-13 and 1561.2-13, decoding group by group: none reads them (best coverage 0.50 < 0.70).
Simple columnar transposition, widths 2-15, on 1569.3-10; Caesar shifts on 1561.5-13: no Spanish.

Claude Fable 5.2 (one API run, 1561.3-13 held out): 8 x 8 turning grille, holes derived from the nulls X/Z of the second block of 1551.3-4; one grille for 1551.3-4, 1561.5-13 and 1569.3-10; and 1561.7-13 is the Clave G.A. once the coded groups are joined.

Grille checked with our own decoder: five blocks of 64 letters (1551.3-4 both, 1561.5-13 first, 1569.3-10 first two) give Spanish with no repair; two declared repairs (one deletion in 1561.5-13, one insertion in 1569.3-10) for the shifted blocks. 1561.7-13 decoded with the validated card: DR, CLAVE, FONDOS, PARQUE.

Preregistered single measure of the grille on the held-out telegram 1561.3-13 (127 letters): car4 0.520 vs threshold 0.70; best of 400 controls 0.402 (200 random grilles), margin +0.118 vs +0.30 required: NOT validated. Cause: a letter lost in the group YPXB shifts the second block; the first block reads. A post-hoc trial is not counted.
Readings counted with Daniel Bourdeau's 95 % rule: 1561.7-13 21/21; grille 1551.3-4 17/17, 1569.3-10 25/26, 1561.5-13 15/17.

validation.notes: Not run with docs/_validate.py. The Clave G.A. card is validated separately against period decipherments of eight sibling telegrams (A = 0.866 on 769 cipher letters, controls at most 0.257; VALIDATION.md). The turning grille FAILED its preregistered single measure on the held-out telegram 1561.3-13: car4 0.520 vs 0.70, margin +0.118 vs +0.30 (a letter lost in YPXB shifts block 2); the post-hoc trial is not counted (VALIDATION_grille.md).

outcome.method_basis: The Clave G.A. telegrams are read with the archive's own card, applied unchanged and validated against period decipherments. The turning grille was recovered from the cipher alone (nulls of 1551.3-4); it is not validated: the preregistered measure on the held-out 1561.3-13 failed (car4 0.520 < 0.70; margin +0.118 < +0.30) because a letter is lost in that telegram. It rests on five 64-letter blocks read with no repair, against 200 random grilles at most 0.402.

credits.note: transcription of the telegrams and of the Clave G.A. card, validation of the card on eight sibling telegrams, readings of 1432.1-4 and 1561.7-13; turning grille proposed by Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic) in one API run, checked by us with an independent decoder, preregistered measure on held-out 1561.3-13 failed (0.520 vs 0.70), three telegrams read in part

Earlier readings in the fonds with other cards: hernandez1911 (Echols), mexico1911 (Prabal Gupta). Originals held by the CEHM (Fundación Carlos Slim).

texts.label: Telegram of 29 March 1911 to John McCarty (CEHM-Carso CMXV.15.1432.1-4)
texts.summary: González Garza at El Paso to Adolfo González at San Antonio: on the 13th Dr (probably Madero) and Ag separated at Galeana, one towards Guerrero, the other towards Chihuahua, camping on the 23rd at Encinillas.

reading_review.note: Read as Spanish sentences: the six decoded words fill the gaps of the clear text (place names on the Galeana-Chihuahua road, Dr, Ag) and make coherent clauses; two faulty pairs corrected by the sense.

texts.label: Telegram of 19 April 1911 to Adolfo González, Clave G.A. (CEHM-Carso CMXV.16.1561.7-13)
texts.summary: González Garza to Adolfo González: Dr wants Elías to come too; keep using the old key while the crisis lasts, it is quicker; send funds and ammunition of all kinds at once.

reading_review.note: All four coded words decode letter for letter with the validated card and complete the clear sentences.

texts.label: Three telegrams of 18-20 April 1911 in the turning grille (CEHM-Carso CMXV.16.1551.3-4, 1561.5-13, 1569.3-10)
texts.summary: San Antonio and El Paso, 18-20 April 1911, before Ciudad Juárez: water for the forces and funds; Dr ready to attack Juárez, armistice probable, funds insufficient; an American officer advises against assaulting a mined Juárez and for attacking in three eight-hour shifts. Key not validated.

reading_review.note: Read as Spanish sentences; five letters corrected by the sense in 1561.5-13, two single S unresolved; two declared repairs; key not validated by the preregistered measure.
